says: Opening a watch makes `Msg.open` with Schema `make` from a client id that arrives over the object's `open` call with no decode.
proof: In: next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts:2650 `open: (client: string) => attributed(runner.open(client))` takes the id over RPC and decodes nothing. Make: next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/WatchersSql.ts:116 `step(Msg.cases.open.make({ watch: { client, at, position: whole.rev } }))`, whose `client` is `Schema.NonEmptyString.check(Schema.isMaxLength(256))` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/internal/watchers.ts:5).
cost: An empty or overlong client id is refused as a typed `WatchersError` with reason `Storage`, because the make runs inside `stored`'s `Effect.try`, not as a defect. The cost is the wrong reason: decision 0215 wants a decode that answers bad input as bad input. This was the same before #1619.
